description: Given an open-source package (PyPI, npm, Go, Cargo, Maven, NuGet or RubyGems) and optionally a version, returns its known vulnerabilities from OSV.dev (IDs, CVE aliases, severity, fixed-in versions), license, latest version, publish date and deprecation status from deps.dev, plus a one-line recommendation. For coding agents to call before adding or upgrading a dependency. Not charged if the package or version does not exist. Costs $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.

name.description: Package name as published, e.g. requests or @types/node

version.description: Exact version; omit for the latest

name: package_check
title: Open-source package check
